cards.title: The anchor caption mode

aliases.name: THE CAPTION MOVES UNDER A CARD

cards.does: A caption page whose first word falls while a dock is live is stamped anchor: under a card it keeps its stage size in the band the page leaves free (E62) and drops to the quiet lower third only when no band fits.
cards.when: the stage size in the free band under a card, quiet only when no band fits

options.means: Page-pinned anchor caption: A ledger page pins its captions to the anchor strip for its whole span (a host plate's quiet zone is the host's).
The caption's band under a card: The compiler writes, on each dock entry, the band the page leaves free of the card; the player moves the stage-size strip there.
Quiet caption: The static lower-third strip: smaller, a single fade, keywords still coloured, no punch - now only when no band holds the stage-size caption clear of the card (48 px / 800 floor on a…

cards.title: The phrase caption style
cards.does: The whole caption page lands as one readable phrase (a 30 ms stagger), every word legible at once; only keywords re-pop and take the red box at their spoken time; landed words boil.
cards.when: a short - the strip is read as one phrase, never chased word by word

author.key: `caption_style="phrase"` passed by build_short.py to the compiler (CAPTION_STYLE)

lives.note: engine `const PHRASE = TL.caption_style === "phrase"` + the caption block's phrase branch

callable.why: any value is accepted; only "phrase" does anything

cards.title: The STAGE caption mode
cards.does: With no card up the caption IS the motion: centred in the page's quiet zone at 64 px / 800, each word popping at its own spoken time with a settling tilt, keywords in the accent.
cards.when: no dock is up and the plate or page holds - the words carry the motion

author.key: compiler-stamped `cap_mode: "stage"` per caption page + timeline `caption_modes: ["stage", "anchor"]` (no row key)

phases.name: pop
phases.does: each word enters at its own spoken time, scale 1.16 -> 1.0, its alternating tilt settling to 0

phases.name: lift
phases.does: the spoken word lifts while the voice is on it

phases.name: band move
phases.does: under a card the strip keeps its size and moves to the band the compiler wrote (E62); quiet only when no band fits

options.means: The staggered fade-up: The page's words rise 22 px through a 5 px blur from scale 0.92 on one minimum-jerk envelope over 0.34 s, 0.055 s apart - a wave, not a queue of pops.
The pop: Each stage word pops in at its own spoken time - the arrival every shipped build uses (no field is written).

lives.note: render caption block + the template's `#caption.stage` CSS
